name: Waffles
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: Sweet milk that has been boiled and cooled
ingredients.originalText: Sweet milk that has been boiled and cooled

instructions.text: Wet the flour with a little sweet milk that has been boiled and cooled
Stir in enough of the milk to form a thick batter
Add a tablespoonful of melted butter, a teaspoonful of salt, and yeast to raise it
When light add two well-beaten eggs
Heat your waffle-iron, grease it well and fill it with the batter
Bake two or three minutes on one side
Turn the iron over, and when brown on both sides the cake is done

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Wet the flour with a little sweet milk that has been boiled and cooled
2. Stir in enough of the milk to form a thick batter
3. Add a tablespoonful of melted butter, a teaspoonful of salt, and yeast to raise it
4. When light add two well-beaten eggs
5. Heat your waffle-iron, grease it well and fill it with the batter
6. Bake two or three minutes on one side
7. Turn the iron over, and when brown on both sides the cake is done
8. Serve immediately
